messages:
maria: OK team — I dropped the PRD draft for the Optimize tooling bundle here: https://redwood/notes/optimize-prd-v1
maria: main ask from sales: predictable 20-30% per-token cost reduction for chat workloads and an SLA on p95 gen latency impact <= +20ms
alex: skimmed. Q: are we treating quantization recommendations as prescriptive changes or advisory guidance in v1?
devin: my vote = advisory only. v1 should provide recommended profiles + confidence score, not auto-apply. customers asked for control.
sophia: agree. also need clear acceptance criteria: 1) end-to-end eval harness runs on canonical prompt sets; 2) no more than 2% BLEU/ROUGE/LLM-quality regression vs baseline for each profile.
maria: put those into the PRD. add a gating rule: any quant profile that fails regression -> flagged and excluded from auto-suggestions.
alex: for batching/caching, customers want latency guarantees. Proposal: expose three knobs in UI/SDK: target latency (ms), cost weight, and cache TTL. Default smart profile chooses batching window to meet target latency.
devin: edge cases: long-prefix reuse (e.g., chat history 8k tokens) — KV cache should not blow memory when prefix hit rate low. We need an eviction policy and an estimated memory scoring output in the recommend UI.
sophia: add acceptance test: simulate 1000 concurrent users with 30% prefix reuse; mem growth < X% and p95 within SLA.
tyler: dependency: serving runtime needs per-request estimated token budget for batching decision. @infra-bot can we get a signal from runtime team?
infra-bot: noted. filing infra ticket INF-1023 to add batching-advisor hook (ETA 2 sprints).
maria: launch criteria checklist (draft):
- docs + SDK examples
- eval harness with baseline and regression checks passed
- UI/CLI recommend flows implemented
- canary rollout to internal customers + 2 pilot customers (acme, lark)
- runbook for quant regressions and rollback
alex: suggest we require a measurable business metric before GA: 10% cost savings on pilot workloads OR no quality regression + maintained latency.
devin: also need telemetry: per-profile suggested vs accepted rate, change in token-cost, and quality deltas. Add to console dashboard export.
sophia: edge-case: mixed-precision models where kernel support varies by hardware. PRD should list fallback behavior: if quant profile not supported on target device, mark as "incompatible" and route to nearest supported hardware or degrade to advisory only.
maria: outstanding scope negotiation items for product: auto-apply quant? (no for v1), per-tenant recommended profiles (yes), UI for manual accept/rollback (yes), ML-only internal flag to try risky profiles (yes)
alex: timeline ask from PM: ship canary in 6 weeks. is that realistic given infra ticket + eval harness?
tyler: 6 weeks tight. infra hook + eval harness + UI + telemetry is ~8-10 dev weeks. can we cut scope: drop per-tenant UI for canary and run via SDK flag for pilots?
maria: ok propose phased rollout: canary (SDK flag pilots) -> 4 weeks -> UI-enabled GA. update PRD schedule and sent to PM.
devin: I'll draft the acceptance criteria section with concrete test commands and eval thresholds.
sophia: I'll add the edge cases matrix (long-prefix, low-hit cache, hardware incompat) and mapping to runbook items.
alex: I'll own the launch metrics dashboard and telemetry events spec.
maria: thanks. last bit: include one customer ask verbatim from acme: "We need checks that quantization won't regress our hallucination rate for financial summaries" — add hallucination monitoring to eval harness.
infra-bot: reminder: weekly "PRD reviews" meeting: Thu 10am. Added PRD-review agenda item.
maria: cool. I'll update the PRD and ping reviewers when done. :thumbsup:
